rows.label: Non-current assets
rows.source: Vitafoam Nigeria Plc audited consolidated and separate financial statements for the year ended 30 September 2025 (NGX filing), consolidated statement of financial position, printed in N thousand, read from the filing page 56 image layer: non-current assets 17,176,064 (2025) and 17,211,945 (2024); current assets 48,099,325 and 34,998,782; total assets 65,275,389 and 52,210,727; non-current liabilities 8,138,720 and 5,679,218; current liabilities 21,582,208 and 21,501,726; total liabilities 29,720,928 and 27,180,944; total equity 35,554,461 and 25,029,783. The filing ties: 17,176,064 plus 48,099,325 equals 65,275,389; 8,138,720 plus 21,582,208 equals 29,720,928; 35,554,461 plus 29,720,928 equals 65,275,389. The stored total assets and total liabilities had both taken a truncated subtotal (equity plus non-current liabilities), which made the stored current liabilities larger than the stored total liabilities; the current liabilities themselves were already the printed figure and are unchanged.
